title: decree-api.yml
description: The config of decree-api, the HTTP front door of a decree 0.5 project (SPEC.md §3). Every key is optional except `endpoints`, each endpoint's `path` and `message.machine`, and a resolvable secret. This schema checks the shape; `decree-api -check` checks the rest: that paths do not conflict, patterns compile, placeholders are path parameters, machines and their data exist, secrets are set, and decree runs.

project.description: The directory that holds .decree/, relative to this file.

listen.description: The address to listen on, host:port. Keep it on localhost behind a TLS reverse proxy. Overridden by DECREE_API_LISTEN when that is set. Takes effect only on restart.

secret_env.description: The environment variable holding the default bearer secret, at least 32 characters (generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`). Secrets never appear in this file, so it can be committed.

decree.description: The decree binary (0.5 or newer): a name on PATH or a path.

daemon.description: The supervised `decree daemon` (SPEC.md §5). Takes effect only on restart.

enabled.description: Supervise `decree daemon` in the project: start it before listening, restart it with back-off when it exits, and stop it on shutdown.

interval.description: Passed to the daemon as --interval: how often it processes the project.

limits.description: The request body cap and the two global rate budgets (SPEC.md §6).

max_body_bytes.description: The largest request body, in bytes. A larger one is a 413.

rate_window.description: The length of the fixed window both rate budgets are counted in.

rate_max.description: Authenticated requests per window, all endpoints together. When spent: 429 with Retry-After.

rate_fail_max.description: Rejected requests per window (bad auth, unknown path, wrong method). When spent, they get 429; authenticated requests are unaffected.

builtins.description: The built-in endpoints (SPEC.md §7). GET /healthz is always served. A configured endpoint may not use a path an enabled built-in uses.

status.description: GET /runs/{id}: a run's `decree status`, with the default secret.

replies.description: POST /runs/{wait_id}/replies/{event}: reply to a run waiting for a person, with `decree event`, with the default secret.

openapi.description: GET /openapi.json: an OpenAPI 3.1 document of the endpoints, without auth (it reveals paths, not secrets).

endpoints.description: The endpoints: each turns an authenticated POST into a decree message, written by `decree emit`.

duration.description: decree's duration format: a positive whole number and s, m, h or d.

envName.description: The name of an environment variable.

endpoint.description: One endpoint: POST <path> emits a message for one machine.

path.description: `/` followed by literal segments and `{name}` segments, one full segment per parameter (`\w+`). No `..`, no empty segments, and no path under an enabled built-in. One trailing slash on a request is ignored.

secret_env.description: The environment variable holding this endpoint's own secret, instead of the top-level `secret_env`. Give an endpoint that reaches a powerful machine its own.

patterns.description: A Go RE2 regular expression per path parameter, anchored automatically, replacing the default `[A-Za-z0-9_\-!]+`. A parameter that does not fully match is a 400, never repaired.

body.description: `required`: a blank body is a 400. `optional`: an empty body is allowed. `none`: any body is a 400. The body reaches decree on stdin, as the message body.

machine.description: The decree machine, `.decree/machines/<name>.yml` in the project. Fixed: a placeholder is not allowed here.

params.description: Values for the machine's `data`, passed to `decree emit` as --param in the order listed. Each key must be in the machine's data and each literal match its type. A string may hold `{{name}}` placeholders for path parameters, which require string data; every path parameter must be used.
